Jan Markiewski

Jan Markiewski’s research portfolio: immunology, cancer biology, computational analysis, publications, and research experience at TTUHSC and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center.

Research affiliations: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center; Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center; Harvard Medical School Immunology Undergraduate Summer Program.
